title: Plugin
description: What a plugin declares about itself in its plugin.json. The cockpit is the surface; plugins bring the mechanisms — a reader for the card and the working view, its actions (defined here, released per instance), optionally a whole web application mounted under /m/<id>/app. A customer's own tool is attached the same way: a manifest, a reader, and the sources it needs released in cockpit.toml. A plugin runs inside the cockpit's process with the cockpit's rights: the access layer governs readers that go through it, it cannot stop code that does not. Install plugins you have read.

reader.description: Dotted module providing read(), and optionally detail() and document().

app.description: A web application the plugin brings, mounted inside the cockpit.

factory.description: package.module:function taking a config path and returning an ASGI app.

path.description: Where the package lives, relative to the manifest.

config.description: Default config file for the factory.

mounts_under_prefix.description: true when the app builds its links from request.scope['root_path'] — the one requirement for mounting.

needs.description: Source names the plugin works with, in the order the module's `sources` should list them. An action's `tool` and `data` refer to these names; the instance maps them to its own source ids by position.

actions.description: The plugin's actions: forms that run the tool owning the data. Defined here once; an instance releases the sources, may restrict to a subset (`actions = [...]` on the module) and may add its own actions in cockpit.toml, but never redefines these.

locales.description: Directory of <lang>.json files merged into the cockpit's, relative to the manifest.

icon.description: The plugin's glyph, from the cockpit's built-in set — on its card, its page and in the rail.

accent.description: The plugin's colour, used for its glyph. State colours stay the state's.

label.description: A locale key or a literal.

tool.description: "plugin" (the script sits in the plugin directory) or a name from `needs` (a released script of the customer's).

command.description: The script, relative to the plugin directory or inside the tool source.

args.description: argv template; "{field}" is substituted, an empty optional value drops its flag.

data.description: A name from `needs`: the source the tool works on (COCKPIT_DATA_DIR). Must be released read-write.

stdin.description: Name of a field whose value goes to the tool on stdin.

options_from.description: "<file>:<path>" inside the action's data source — a schema property's enum ("review.schema.json:status") or a list in the data itself ("todo.json:lov.clusters", ids of the entries). The value list lives in the data, not here.
